scope: Japanese cash equities and ETFs via Rakuten Securities/iSPEED

capitalRules.dailyGrossPurchaseLimitNote: 固定の1日購入総額上限は設けない。複数銘柄同時保有可。1銘柄あたりの投入上限は150万円。
capitalRules.basicTradeUnit: 100 shares as a base, but position size may vary within risk and capital limits

lossRules.twoConsecutiveStopsRule: After two consecutive stop-loss trades, stop opening new day trades for the session unless explicitly re-planned under a swing thesis.

daytradeToSwingPolicy.principle: A position entered as a day trade may be reclassified to a swing if the investment thesis, sector/macro backdrop, price structure and expected value still support holding beyond the session.
requiredBeforeCarry: Re-evaluate the thesis using information available before the close
Define first and final profit targets
Check total capital tied up and portfolio downside
daytradeToSwingPolicy.notAllowed: Do not extend holding solely because the position is in loss without a valid swing thesis.

averagingDownPolicy.principle: Do not average down merely to lower the average cost. Add only when the thesis remains valid, price is near a defined support area, rebound/confirmation is visible, and total downside remains acceptable.
averagingDownPolicy.repeatAdds: Avoid repeated mechanical averaging down in the same name.
